name: hcapp_getEventRsvps
description: Returns RSVP attendance data for a specific event, accessible by any authenticated app user (no admin role required). Returns the same Hashers and HasherEventMap column shapes as hcapp_syncEventAdminData so the client can reuse the same sync infrastructure, but deliberately omits contact info (email, phoneNumber are returned as NULL). HasherKennelMap, Payments, and Receipts rowsets are not returned — those remain admin-only. Both rowsets are watermark-gated: if the watermark is 'ignore', that rowset is skipped entirely.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. SP number 75 — auth errorCode range 1175 (token) / 1375 (device not found).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret. Default 'none' not set on this SP — caller must always provide.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to fetch RSVPs for. NULL or zero-UUID returns errorCode 1272, errorType 2.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for the Hashers rowset. Pass 'ignore' (or NULL, or a date <= '2000-01-01') to skip the Hashers rowset entirely. Otherwise pass a DATETIMEOFFSET string — rows with updatedAt > this value are returned.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for the HasherEventMap rowset. Pass 'ignore' (or NULL, or a date <= '2000-01-01') to skip the HEM rowset entirely. Otherwise pass a DATETIMEOFFSET string — rows with updatedAt > this value are returned.

parameters.name: usePaging
parameters.description: 1 = enforce page limits (2500 rows for Hashers, 250 rows for HasherEventMap). 0 or NULL = unlimited (internally 1,000,000 row cap). Default 0.

rowsets.name: AuthOrValidationError
rowsets.description: Returned when HC6.ValidateAppAuth fails or @eventId is NULL/zero-UUID. On auth failure the shape comes directly from ValidateAppAuth OUTPUT params. On eventId failure, errorCode=1272, errorType=2. Mutually exclusive with Hashers and HasherEventMap rowsets.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: HC.ErrorLog GUID.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification (1=auth, 3=device not found, 2=validation).

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title.

columns.name: errorUserMessage
columns.description: User-facing error message.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: SP name via OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID).

rowsets.name: Hashers
rowsets.description: Returned at index 0 when @hashersUpdatedAfter != 'ignore' and auth succeeds. Global hasher updates since the watermark. Same column shape as hcapp_syncEventAdminData. Omits contact info. Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. May be empty (zero rows). Mutually exclusive with error rowset. Note: if both watermarks are != 'ignore', Hashers is rowset 0 and HasherEventMap is rowset 1.

columns.name: hasherId
columns.description: Hasher.id — internal PK.

columns.name: firstName
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.FirstName, ''). Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL.

columns.name: lastName
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.LastName, ''). Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL.

columns.name: dispName
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.DisplayName, '') — persisted computed column.

columns.name: hashName
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.HashName, ''). Table column is NVARCHAR(250) NULL.

columns.name: photo
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.Photo, ''). Table column is NVARCHAR(1000) NULL.

columns.name: dispPref

columns.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.IncludeInGlobalHashDirectory, 0). Table column is SMALLINT NOT NULL.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), CAST(COALESCE(h.updatedAt, GETDATE()) AS DATETIME2)) — updatedAt as a string, timezone offset stripped.

columns.name: removed
columns.description: COALESCE(Hasher.Removed, 0). Table column is SMALLINT NULL.

rowsets.name: HasherEventMap
rowsets.description: Returned when @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore' and auth succeeds. Event-scoped HEM rows updated since the watermark for @eventId. Same column shape as hcapp_syncEventAdminData, with email and phoneNumber hardcoded to NULL. Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. May be empty (zero rows). Index is 1 when Hashers rowset is also emitted, or 0 if only this rowset is emitted.

sideEffects: Writes to HC.ErrorLog on @eventId validation failure.
No writes on auth failure — ValidateAppAuth writes its own error log entries.

codeSmells.issue: hemEventStartDatetime loses timezone offset via CONVERT to DATETIME2
codeSmells.detail: Both EventStartDatetime and FbEventStartDatetime are DATETIMEOFFSET(7) but the SP strips the offset with CONVERT(DATETIME2, ...). This is the same pattern as hcapp_getRuns. Client receives local time with no UTC offset.

Both Hashers.updatedAt and HasherEventMap.updatedAt are stringified via CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), CAST(... AS DATETIME2)), stripping the timezone offset. Clients must parse the string and treat it as local time.

breakingChanges: email and phoneNumber columns are always NULL in this SP — callers that expect real values must use the admin-only hcapp_syncEventAdminData instead.

Rowset index depends on which watermarks are non-'ignore': if only HasherEventMap is requested, it arrives at index 0. If both are requested, Hashers is 0 and HasherEventMap is 1. Clients must not assume a fixed index.
